items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And uh, gave it to, let's see, Herb Alpert and uh, a few people.

ctx.x: What was your thinking musically on these projects?

Uh, well, uh, tryin' to, uh, formulate … Well I, what I, what I actually, what I did was uh, uh, applied in a musical way with two tracks from this first. You know, I made two, two tracks of what I planned to do with the, a lot of the same musicians that ended up being on it. And uh, gave it to, let's see, Herb Alpert and uh, a few people. George Butler liked it. He said, "Let's get him now." And so …
